scripts.desktop:prep: npm run build && rm -rf desktop/app && cp -r dist desktop/app && rm -f desktop/app/sw.js && (cd desktop && npm install --no-audit --no-fund)
scripts.desktop: npm run desktop:prep && cd desktop && npx electron .
scripts.desktop:win: npm run desktop:prep && cd desktop && npm run pack:win && cd ../desktop-dist && python3 -c "import shutil; shutil.make_archive('CatsOffice-win32-x64', 'zip', '.', 'CatsOffice-win32-x64')"
scripts.desktop:linux: npm run desktop:prep && cd desktop && npm run pack:linux && cd ../desktop-dist && rm -f CatsOffice-linux-x64.tar.gz && tar czf CatsOffice-linux-x64.tar.gz CatsOffice-linux-x64
